name: implement-scim follows the skill
prompt: Add SCIM. I want to provision users from a directory.

judge.check: Agent followed implement-scim. It called verifyWebhookPayload before reading the event, upserted users, and deactivated on user_deleted. It did not hard-delete.

Agent asked the human to write missing SCALEKIT_ENVIRONMENT_URL, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_ID, SCALEKIT_CLIENT_SECRET, and SCALEKIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET names into .env. It did not invent those values. It did not invent organization IDs.
Agent named implement-sso only for the admin portal so IT can turn on the directory.
Agent did not write SaaSKit login or an SSO admin portal embed.
